data.title: Income Tax Assessment 2024 – Back Payment Due
data.summary: Finanzamt Musterbach (tax office) issued the 2024 income tax, solidarity surcharge and church tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for Jonas Mustermann. It sets a taxable income of 61,240 EUR and income tax of 15,130.00 EUR, resulting in a back payment (Nachzahlung) of 1,236.00 EUR due on 05.02.2026.
data.explanation: This letter is your official tax bill (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2024. It shows the tax office calculated more tax than was already withheld from your salary, so you owe an additional 1,236.00 EUR by the stated due date. Pay it by bank transfer using the tax office's account and your Steuernummer as reference to avoid late-payment interest. If you disagree with the assessment, you can file an objection (Einspruch) with the tax office, but this must reach them by the deadline shown, which is calculated from when the letter is legally considered delivered. Your craftsman-service deduction (§ 35a EStG) was already included. If the amounts seem wrong, consider consulting a tax advisor (Steuerberater).
data.tax_note: This is the official annual income tax assessment for 2024, confirming the assessed tax, withheld wage tax, the accepted deduction for craftsman services (Handwerkerleistungen, § 35a EStG), and the resulting back payment; keep for tax records.

items.title: Pay income tax back payment (Nachzahlung)
items.action: Transfer the amount to the Finanzamt's account using the stated reference.

items.title: Object to tax assessment (Einspruch einlegen)
items.action: If you disagree with the assessment, file a written, electronic, or recorded objection (Einspruch) with Finanzamt Musterbach by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If no objection is filed in time, the assessment becomes final (bestandskräftig).
